note: Per-machine budgets for `pnpm footprint`, keyed by `<cpu>|<GiB>|<cores>`. A Mac with no entry here is measured but not gated. Record a machine with `pnpm footprint:baseline` on a quiet Mac (load under half the cores); a busy run records a ceiling and hides the next regression. The M4 Pro entry is provisional: it was recorded on a loaded developer machine and should be re-recorded on the target M1 before anyone trusts the absolute numbers.
